module_summary: Clearable gray-code CDC FIFO: source and destination halves exchange storage and gray pointers across clock domains, plus a bidirectional req/ack clear-phase handshake that lets either side sequence a synchronized FIFO clear.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source-domain payload written into the FIFO storage.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source-side valid requesting a FIFO write.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source-side ready, low when full or clearing.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Destination-domain payload read from the FIFO.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination-side valid when FIFO non-empty and not clearing.

anchors.name: async_data
anchors.why: FIFO storage array written by source, read asynchronously by destination.

anchors.name: async_wptr
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer crossing to destination domain.

anchors.name: async_rptr
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer crossing back to source domain.

anchors.name: src_clear_i
anchors.why: Source-side request to clear the whole FIFO.

anchors.name: dst_clear_i
anchors.why: Destination-side request to clear the whole FIFO.

anchors.name: src_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Indicates a clear sequence is in progress on source side.

anchors.name: dst_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Indicates a clear sequence is in progress on destination side.

anchors.name: async_reset_dst2src_ack
anchors.why: Destination acknowledgment of source clear phase request.

anchors.name: async_reset_src2dst_next_phase
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase (isolate/clear/post-clear) sent source to destination.

anchors.name: async_reset_src2dst_ack
anchors.why: Source acknowledgment of destination clear phase request.

anchors.name: async_reset_dst2src_next_phase
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase sent destination to source.

groups.name: src_half
groups.description: Source write side with storage, gray write pointer and clear controller.

groups.name: dst_half
groups.description: Destination read side with pointer sync, output stream and clear controller.

groups.name: async_fifo_storage
groups.description: Shared storage array crossing the clock domain boundary.

groups.name: clear_handshake
groups.description: Bidirectional req/ack phase handshake sequencing synchronized FIFO clear.
